card.name: Words in all-caps dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Words inside ALL-CAPS label text, mostly dosage and warning instructions, where the next word is likely to be DAILY, DOSAGE or DICKINSON (a capital D). It fires on small linking words and word parts such as TO, A, TIMES, ON and ORED.

modes.label: Linking words in caps warnings
modes.description: Small words such as A or TO inside all-caps warning or administration sentences.
modes.example: THESE REACTIONS ARE MORE LIKELY TO OCCUR IN INDIVIDUALS WITH<< A>> HISTORY OF PENICILLIN HYPER

modes.label: Dose-schedule words in caps
modes.description: Words in capitalized dosage lines just before a D-word such as DAILY or DOSAGE.
modes.example: APPLY PATCH TO AFFECTED AREA 1 TO 2<< TIMES>> DAILY OR AS DIRECTED BY PHYS

modes.label: Partway through a caps name or word
modes.description: Part of a capitalized name or word where a D-word follows, such as BECTON DICKINSON.
modes.example: SAFETYGLIDE ™ INSTRUCTIONS FROM BECT<<ON>> DICKINSON SafetyGlide™

card.writes: It pushes the model toward tokens starting with a capital D, such as D, which fits words like DAILY and DOSAGE.
card.plain: It marks the spot in all-caps label text where the next word is likely to start with D, such as DAILY or DOSAGE.
